Okudingekayo ngaphambilini: ukubala amazinga okukhula (amaphesenti) nokufunda amathebula. y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.c: Uma izihlalo ziyanda, amakhasimende ongawasebenzela ngasikhathi sinye nawo ayanda. Kunzima ukuthi ubheke ukuthi inani lezihlalo alihlobene nokuthengiswa.

Nakuba ukuthengiswa kukhule, ukuthengiswa ngesihlalo ngasinye kwahlala kunjalo noma kwehla. Uma ukwandiswa kwezihlalo kwakuyisizathu sokwenyuka kokuthengiswa, incazelo 'yokukhula' iyashintsha.

y-m-79-03.title: Umkhiqizo owabizwa ngokuthi unephutha yimishini yokuhlola '95% enembile'
y-m-79-03.goal: Qinisekisa ngezinombolo ukuthi uma umphumela wokuhlola uthi 'unephutha', isilinganiso esinephutha ngempela siyahluka kakhulu nezinga lamaphutha (izinga eliyisisekelo) nezinga lokuhlulela ngephutha, futhi uthole wena amacala amaningana anelisa imibandela.
y-m-79-03.material:
Okulandelayo kuyaziwa ngomshini wokuhlola ozenzakalelayo wefektri.
- Izinto ezinephutha ziyi-1% yayo yonke imikhiqizo.
- Isilinganiso sezinto ezinephutha ezehlulelwa njengezinephutha singu-95%.
- Isilinganiso sezinto ezijwayelekile ezehlulelwa ngephutha njengezinephutha singu-5%.

Isikhangiso somshini sithi 'Ukunemba 95%'. Umfundi oyedwa wathi, "Ithuba lokuthi umkhiqizo owabizwa ngumshini ngokuthi unephutha unephutha ngempela lingu-95%," futhi wakusebenza ngale ndlela esebenzisa imikhiqizo engu-10000.

Okudingekayo ngaphambilini: ukubala amaphesenti nemilinganiselo, nendlela yokubeka sonke njengo-10000 nokubala 'bangaki'. (Awudingi ukusebenzisa izindlela zamathuba.) Uma sewufundile amathuba anemibandela, ungahlola inani elifanayo ngefomula.

- Amaphepha angu-9 omklomelo wesibili: ikhadi lesipho lika-2000원
- Amaphepha asele angu-90: angenalutho (akukho mklomelo)

Ikilasi lethu likhokha amakhadi esipho ngenani elibhaliwe. Cabanga ukuthi akukho ezinye izindleko. Umfundi oyedwa wathi, "Ngikhokhe u-1000원, ngathola umklomelo wokuqala, futhi ngathola ikhadi lesipho, ngakho lokhu kudweba kuhle kubahlanganyeli."
